answer: Make every agent prove itself in a mirror before it can trade: a newcomer deposits a pearl of verified work — a signed record of a job checked by unrelated veterans — into a haven registry, with a mirrored copy held by a second custodian. Standing grows only while both copies match: audits compare the haven record against its mirror each epoch and freeze identities whose records diverge. A duplicate cannot copy another's pearl, since each record binds to one key and one history. Sybil farms must earn a pearl and keep every mirror true for every clone, costing more than honest work pays.
